topic: Text Generation: A Systematic Literature Review of Tasks, Evaluation, and Challenges
topic_definition: Stage 2 canonical eligibility, source-faithful to the original paper's screening criteria. Eligible studies are relevant to text generation or natural language generation and can be reviewed for text-generation tasks, methods, datasets, applications, evaluation, challenges, or limitations.
summary: Stage 2 canonical criteria restated from criteria_mds/2405.15604.md; publication-time filtering is handled by cutoff_jsons/2405.15604.json.

summary_topics.description: Text Generation: A Systematic Literature Review of Tasks, Evaluation, and Challenges

required.criterion: Paper is relevant to text generation or natural language generation based on titles and abstracts.
Paper's contribution can be reviewed in relation to text-generation tasks, methods, applications, datasets, evaluation, challenges, or limitations.

exclusion_criteria.criterion: Papers outside the text-generation scope are excluded.
Papers that are too specific for the scope of this review, including multimodality-focused work, are excluded.
Works that mainly employ or apply text generation to another field of study, such as medicine, are excluded when they do not study text generation itself.
